summary: Iteration 61 — Backend-only testing of (1) subscription renewal trigger /api/super-admin/trigger-renewals and (2) User CRM (tags + notes) endpoints in /app/backend/routes/user_crm.py. 22/22 pytest tests passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. RBAC boundaries (resident 403, company_admin cross-compound 403, unauthenticated 401/403) all verified. Validation limits (tag>32 chars, empty tag, note>2000 chars, empty note, nonexistent note/user 404) all correct. Create→GET persistence verified for both tags and notes; update_at/updated_by populated on note PUT; idempotency verified on trigger-renewals and on duplicate POST /tags.
critical_code_review_comments: user_crm.py line 126: `add_tag` returns `tags + [tag]` computed in-process rather than re-reading the updated document. Works only because $addToSet was applied, but if a race/parallel add occurs the returned list could be stale. Consider re-fetching after update for strict consistency.

user_crm.py `_authorize`: role 'security' is allowed to read/write CRM tags+notes on same-compound users. Confirm this is intentional — usually security personnel should not be writing admin CRM notes.

user_crm.py line 107: when a tag already exists, the idempotent branch returns the existing `colors` map WITHOUT updating the color even if the caller passed a new color. Document or fix (upsert-color-on-idempotent-add).

tag-suggestions endpoint ignores compound/company scope — any admin/company_admin sees ALL tags globally across tenants. Consider scoping by compound_id / management_company_id for multi-tenant isolation.
routes/user_crm.py is 261 lines — fine for now, but note the `_authorize` helper is duplicated logic from other user-management routes; consider extracting to a shared rbac util.
